description: 한국수력원자력(주)_수력발전소 주변지역 연간 강우량 [electricity and power and nuclear facilities] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국수력원자력(주). 이 데이터는 2023년부터 2025년까지 한국수력원자력에서 운영하는 화천, 춘천, 의암, 청평, 팔당, 칠보, 보성강, 강릉, 괴산 등 9개 수력발전소 주변 지역의 연간 강우량을 정리한. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국수력원자력(주). Its tags are 수력, 발전소, 강우량, 9개소, 연간 강우량. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-09-17 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
